data.name: Main_DisableFailSafeMessage
data.value:
Turn off automatic safe mode?
Without it, LinkFlow will NOT run the fans and the pump at 100% when the CPU, the GPU or the coolant reaches its critical temperature, when the pump stops or when the sensors stop responding. This can cause overheating and damage the hardware.
Alerts keep showing up, and the change is recorded in the log.
